title.en: Julu: Xiang Yu breaks the siege
title.zh: 巨鹿：项羽击破围城秦军

summary.en: The Shiji tells how Xiang Yu crossed the river, sank boats and broke cooking vessels before attacking the Qin forces around Julu. Its account names Wang Li among those captured after nine engagements. Zhang Han’s negotiated surrender belongs to a later stage of the campaign.
summary.zh: 《史记》叙述项羽渡河后沉船、破釜甑，进攻围困巨鹿的秦军；记九战后俘获王离。章邯议降则是随后战事中的另一阶段。

title.en: Pengcheng: Xiang Yu defeats the Han coalition
title.zh: 彭城：项羽击败汉军联盟

summary.en: The Shiji reports a coalition of 560,000 under the King of Han and a selected force of 30,000 led by Xiang Yu. It describes Xiang Yu attacking from the west in the morning, defeating the coalition by midday, and pursuing soldiers toward the rivers with heavy loss of life. These figures belong to the ancient narrative.
summary.zh: 《史记》记汉王合诸侯兵五十六万，项羽率精兵三万回师；叙述项羽清晨从西面进攻，至中午击败汉军，并追击至河流一带，造成严重伤亡。兵力与损失数字来自古代叙事。

title.en: The Hong Canal pact and renewed pursuit

summary.en: In the Shiji, dwindling Chu supplies lead to an agreement: lands west of the Hong Canal go to Han, those east to Chu, and Liu Bang’s family is released. After Xiang Yu withdraws east, Zhang Liang and Chen Ping persuade the Han king to pursue him. The settlement is followed by renewed war.
summary.zh: 《史记》将楚军断粮与议和相连：鸿沟以西归汉，以东归楚，并释放刘邦家属。项羽东撤后，张良、陈平劝汉王追击，短暂议和随即转为继续交战。

title.en: Gaixia and Xiang Yu’s last retreat
title.zh: 垓下与项羽的最后退却

summary.en: The Shiji describes Xiang Yu’s army short of food and surrounded at Gaixia, hearing Chu songs from the Han camps at night. Xiang Yu breaks out southward. The narrative follows him through pursuit to Wujiang, where he refuses a ferry crossing and takes his own life.
summary.zh: 《史记》叙述项羽军粮尽兵少，被围垓下，夜闻汉军四面唱楚歌。项羽向南突围；叙事随后追踪他被追击至乌江、拒绝渡江并自尽的过程。

summary.en: After presenting Han Xin’s advice on winning support in Guanzhong, the Shiji’s biography says the King of Han deployed his generals and moved east through Chencang in the eighth month. It then records the pacification of the Three Qin territories. The passage is a brief campaign sequence.
summary.zh: 《史记·淮阴侯列传》先记韩信分析关中人心、提出东进之策，随后记汉王部署诸将，八月东出陈仓、平定三秦。这段文字以简短的次序交代进军。

title.en: Jingxing: the river formation and captured camp
title.zh: 井陉：背水列阵与夺取营垒

summary.en: The Shiji says Han Xin and Zhang Er faced Zhao troops claimed to number 200,000. Han Xin placed a force with its back to the water while sending 2,000 light cavalry toward the Zhao camp. When Zhao soldiers pursued, the detachment replaced their banners with Han flags, helping turn the fighting into a rout.
summary.zh: 《史记》记韩信、张耳面对号称二十万的赵军。韩信一部背水列阵，另遣轻骑二千人窥伺赵营；赵军出营追击后，骑兵进入营垒，拔赵旗、立汉旗，促成赵军溃败。

sources.title: 《史记》卷92 · Shiji 92
sources.author: 司马迁 · Sima Qian
sources.evidenceNote: Jingxing paragraphs, lines 140–141: Zhao’s number is explicitly claimed (號稱); Han Xin and Zhang Er, river formation and flag-changing detachment.
sources.evidenceNoteZh: 井陉段（140—141行）明确为“号称二十万”；包括韩信、张耳、背水阵与换旗奇兵。

context.en: This nineteenth- to early twentieth-century portrait presents Xiang Yu as a forceful character. The Julu narrative follows the much earlier Shiji account.
context.zh: 这幅19世纪至20世纪初的项羽像着力表现人物气势；巨鹿故事则依据更早的《史记》叙述。

context.en: The later portrait singles out Xiang Yu, the commander of the counterattack, rather than reconstructing the battlefield.
context.zh: 后世画像突出反攻指挥者项羽这一人物，而非重建战场。

context.en: The portrait names Xiang Yu, one party to the pact. Its late date makes it a study of his remembered image, while the text supplies the negotiations.
context.zh: 画像标识议和一方项羽。其较晚年代使它成为观察人物后世形象的材料，谈判过程则见文字记载。

context.en: Compare the late portrait’s assertive face with the Shiji’s account of retreat and defeat. Both shape how Xiang Yu is remembered, in different media and periods.
context.zh: 可将后世画像中强烈的面部神态，与《史记》中的退却和败亡叙述并读。两者以不同时代的媒介塑造项羽的记忆。

context.en: Han Xin is the figure at left in this later album; Xiao He is at right. The pairing recalls the adviser’s rise, not a scene on the Chencang route.
context.zh: 后世像册左页为韩信、右页为萧何。并置的人物让读者联想到韩信获荐与受用，并非陈仓进军场景。

context.en: The left-hand figure is Han Xin, named on the album leaf. Xiao He at right belongs to the album pairing, not to the Jingxing battlefield account.
context.zh: 左页题名韩信。右页萧何属于像册中的人物并置，并非井陉战场叙事中的参战者。

reusedImageEvidence: Two previously admitted local images reused without new downloads. Source metadata and exact identities inspected; Han Xin is at left, Xiao He at right. New primary-text readings establish the six narrative connections, not original likenesses.
limits: Shiji is an ancient historical narrative, not independent verification of its troop or casualty totals. Dates and map anchors were retained. Image rights metadata is retained from prior admission, not claimed freshly reverified.
